deadline.value: Fall 2027 Graduate School deadline is August 16, 2027 (Spring 2027: January 12, 2027; Summer 2027: June 7, 2027), with no separate departmental admission deadline posted. Apply before February 15, 2027 if seeking nomination for the Graduate School First-Year Graduate Fellowship ($6,000).

also.quote: Programs may nominate up to five eligible incoming (first year) graduate students by February 15th annually.

gre_general.value: Neither the Physics Ph.D. webpage nor the Ph.D. handbook specifies a GRE General Test requirement (only the Physics GRE is specified for international transcripts).

gre_subject.value: Applicants with international transcripts must take the ETS Physics GRE Subject Test; minimum score for regular admission is 520-550.
gre_subject.quote: Students with international transcripts must take the Physics GRE exam. A minimum score for regular admission is in the range of 520-550.

also.quote: students with international transcripts must take the Physics GRE exam. A minimum score for regular admission is in the range of 520-550.

toefl_min.value: Physics department page and handbook specify a minimum TOEFL iBT of 83 (560 PBT), which is stricter than the Graduate School chart's legacy 80 iBT / 4.5 (1-6 scale effective 1/21/2026); an oral interview with Physics faculty may also be required.
toefl_min.quote: Applicants for whom English is a second language must complete the TOEFL exam with a minimum score of 560 (paper-based exam) or 83 (internet-based exam) or 220 (internet-based exam).

english_waiver.value: Physics states the English test requirement can be waived only if the student has successfully completed one year of full-time academic study at a U.S. institution; an English-medium degree from India alone does not waive it, and an oral interview with Physics faculty may also be required.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants for whom English is a second language must complete the TOEFL exam with a minimum score of 560 (paper-based exam) or 83 (internet-based exam) or 220 (internet-based exam). A band score of 6.5 on the IELTS is also acceptable. If the student has successfully completed one year of full-time academic study at a U.S. institution, this requirement can be waived.

supervisor.value: Bachelor's entrants are not required to have a pre-committed advisor at admission and must identify a willing dissertation adviser by the time coursework is completed; however, applicants who already hold a Physics Master's degree should contact a potential faculty research adviser in advance.
supervisor.quote: By the time students have successfully completed the coursework requirements of the PhD program, they must identify a dissertation adviser who agrees to supervise their research work. | Applicants who already hold a Masters degree in Physics should discuss their application with a potential faculty research adviser in advance, and mention these discussions in their goal statement.

funding.value: Funding is explicitly NOT guaranteed with admission. Competitive support includes Teaching Assistant positions (~$2,000 per lab plus possible tuition support), hourly Research Assistant positions funded by faculty grants, and Graduate School PhD Grants (up to $26,000/yr) or Tuition Matching Grants (up to $8,000/yr).
funding.quote: Students admitted to the PhD program are NOT guaranteed funding. However, various funding opportunities exist that students are encouraged to look into: 1. Teaching Assistant positions worth roughly $2,000 per lab, plus the possibility of some tuition support.

also.quote: Awards in any amount of up to $26,000 per year, or $13,000 per semester, may be processed by the Office of Financial Aid. | Resident and nonresident graduate students, including international students, are eligible for this grant.

entry_route.value: Requires a bachelor's degree in biological sciences, mathematics, physics, or equivalent with >= 3.0 undergraduate GPA and appropriate undergraduate physics coursework (66-credit program; master's transfer credits may reduce coursework at adviser's discretion).
entry_route.quote: Hold a baccalaureate degree in biological sciences, mathematics, physics or equivalents from an accredited college or university and have an appropriate background of undergraduate physics courses

notes: Official degree track is Applied Science: Physics, Ph.D. Research areas span Solid State and Quantum Physics, Fundamental Magnetism/Spintronics, Nanotechnology & Plasmonics, Liquid Crystals, Bio-Physics, and Nonlinear Physics & Chaos. Department website (83 iBT / 560 PBT, US-study-only waiver) is stricter than Graduate School table (80 legacy / 4.5 effective 1/21/2026); the Physics webpage text '220 (internet-based exam)' reflects the legacy computer-based score typoed as iBT.
